name: Grimstalker Fighter 1
body:
Grimstalker Fighter 1
CR 6

XP 2,400
Male grimstalker fighter 1
NE Medium fey
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+2 armor, +5 Dex, +3 natural)
hp 38 (6d6+12)
Fort +6, Ref +12, Will +7 DR 5/cold iron

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +8 (1d4+4 plus poison), +1 battleaxe +10 (1d8+7 plus poison)
Special Attacks poison (injury, DC 14, 1/rd. for 6 rds., 1d2 Dex, 1 save), sneak attack +3d6
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 8th)

3/day – control plants (DC 21), tree shape

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 25, Con 15, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 14
Base Atk +4; CMB +8; CMD 25
Feats Combat Reflexes, Power Attack, Stealthy, Weapon Focus (battleaxe)
Skills Acrobatics +15, Climb +20, Escape Artist +7, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (nature) +10, Perception +12, Stealth +17 (+25 in forested areas), Survival +12, Swim +13 Racial Modifiers +8 Stealth in forested areas
Languages Common, Elven , Sylvan
Gear +1 battleaxe, gauntlets of ogre power, leaf armor (racial armor that is destroyed when he dies)
